'''Evidence bag 4A''' contained the remains of the [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] [[Darth Vader's secretary|secretary]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. It was mentioned during the trials of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Darth Vader against the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]].<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}</ref>
